text.p: Factory Card Outlet Corp said its underwriters exercised their full overallotment option to buy 394,050 additional shares of the company's common stock at the initial offering price of $9, all of which were sold by the company.
On December 13, 1996, the company completed its initial public offering of 2,627,000 common shares, or which 2,550,000 were sold by Factory Card and 77,000 by certain stockholders.

The company, a chain of superstores offering party supplies, greeting cards and gift wrap, expects proceeds from the overallotment option, along with a $25 million revolving credit facility and cash from operations, will be used to fund its expansion program and working capital requirements.
